review_boundary: This is a 40-video starter slice from a 2,829-video channel manifest. Title and transcript retrieval leads require full-context review and do not establish humor or presentation effectiveness.

items.review_prompt: Does a concrete everyday friction carry the explanatory or comic premise before any generalized claim?
Does the opening premise create an accurate promise that later beats fulfil, complicate, or reverse?
Does the turn replace a real initial frame with a more specific one without relying on a false binary or caricature?
Do character details and point of view materially change how the same everyday subject is understood?
Is the apparent acknowledgment or recovery supported by full audio/video context and transferable without copying stand-up persona?
Does self-inclusion change the risk or relationship of the observation, and where would the move fail because of power or topic?
